leadText: Zippo (Japanese: ジッポ Zippo) was the first Pokémon introduced on Ritchie's team. It is unclear whether Zippo or Sparky was Ritchie's first Pokémon. It first appeared in A Friend in Deed.
plainText:
Zippo (Japanese: ジッポ Zippo) was the first Pokémon introduced on Ritchie's team. It is unclear whether Zippo or Sparky was Ritchie's first Pokémon. It first appeared in A Friend in Deed.

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
 
Zippo was introduced as a during the Indigo Plateau Conference in A Friend In Deed, breaking open a wall in a van trapped Ritchie and in with when Ash's Bulbasaur couldn't do it on its own. In the next episode, during Ritchie's with Ash, Zippo was sent out against Ash's Pikachu when Ritchie's , Happy, was defeated. Even though Pikachu dodged multiple s, he wasn't able to keep up and lost to Zippo's . Zippo's next opponent was . Zippo ran away from Charizard's far stronger Flamethrower after using Flamethrower itself. This caused Ritchie to recall it.

In Friends to the End, it was briefly shown battling Assunta's . It was revealed to have been knocked out later when Ritchie's last Pokémon was shown to be Sparky. In that same episode, it saved Ash's Pikachu along with Sparky when they were captured by Team Rocket.

==== ====
 
In A Parent Trapped!, during the Whirl Islands, Zippo was revealed to have evolved into a . It was sent out along with Ash's Cyndaquil to take on Butch's and Cassidy's . It wasn't able to match up with the opposing Pokémon as the headgear they were wearing made them more powerful.

====Pokémon Chronicles====
In Oaknapped!, Zippo was sent out to take on Butch's . It used Flamethrower on Mightyena but some of the flames landed in 's hair. Zippo then used on it, also hitting Cassidy's . The opposing Pokémon landed on their Trainers, leaving Sparky a chance to blast them off with .

In Celebi and Joy!, Ritchie used Zippo along with Sparky and Rose to defeat the Pokémon of a group of workers who were trying to demolish a Pokémon Center.

===Personality and characteristics===
Zippo, as a Charmander, was willing to battle any opponent, including ones that have evolved as shown when it was battling .

===Appearance===
 

===Moves used===
 
 
 
 
 
 

==In the manga==
 
===The Electric Tale of Pikachu===
 
In The Indigo Finals, Zippo, a fully evolved in this adaptation, fought against Ash's Charizard in the Indigo Plateau Conference. Out of disobedience, Ash's Charizard ended up severely injuring Zippo, forcing Ash to recall Charizard and forfeit.

In the original Japanese version, it retains its nickname of Zippo. However, in the VIZ Media English translation, it is renamed Charley.
